BIPARTISAN INFRASTRUCTURE LAW (BIL) AMERICAN PRODUCTION OF LITHIUM IRON PHOSPHATE AND FUTURE INNOVATION (AMPLIFI)

THE OBJECTIVE OF THE PROJECT IS TO ESTABLISH 15 KILO TONNES PER ANNUM (KTPA) OF DOMESTIC MANUFACTURING CAPABILITY OF IRA-COMPLIANT LITHIUM IRON PHOSPHATE (LFP) CATHODE ACTIVE MATERIALS
